description: Propose an improved build for any approved game on arcade.fun without manual input. Unpacks and runs full sandbox checks, computes a file diff against the live build, and returns a live preview URL. Auto-merges straight to live if you supply the game's creator manage `key` or if the game's `prPolicy` is `auto_merge` and every check passes.

changes.description: Public changelog bullet points if merged.

content_base64.description: The .html or .zip build, base64 encoded. Up to 24 MB decoded.

entry.description: Start page inside a zip, if not index.html.

filename.description: index.html or build.zip, so the type is read correctly.

game.description: 12-character game id or public slug (e.g. quikscope).

key.description: Optional: game's manage key if you are the creator (enables automatic merge).

threads.description: True if the build requires SharedArrayBuffer.

wallet.description: Optional Solana payout address for an optional future coin. Omit for a free listing.

name: submit_pull_request
title: Submit an automated game pull request
